punchline: Daniel Pink's fix for the afternoon slump: drink a coffee, then lie down straight away.
thirty_sec: Afternoons cost more than we think. At Duke, anesthesia errors were more likely in procedures starting around 3 p.m. than in the morning. Danish schoolchildren's test scores slid as the day went on, but a 20 to 30 minute break beforehand more than made up for it. Daniel Pink's own trick: drink a coffee, then nap right away with a 25-minute alarm, so you wake just as the caffeine kicks in.
question: When is the worst time of day for you to make an important decision?
